title: Behind the Curtain
about: The invisible backstage work that makes the performance possible.
description: This track looks behind the spectacle of Pirate Year at the small jobs the audience never saw. During Nick's solo, I helped operate the trapdoor for his entrance, opening it, holding it through the cue, and closing it once he was safely onstage. It captures the satisfaction of doing work that receives no applause or spotlight but is essential to making the performance come alive.
lyrics: The costumes and the pirate fights.
The cheers that fill the crowded room,
The music lifting through the gloom.
Waiting for their cue with skill.
Listening for the time to go.
Lift him up into the light,
Close the door and clear from sight.
How many hands pulled him through.
No one calling out your name.
Still we'd do it all again,
Just to help the story live.
